thought.text: Admin login works (302 on POST, /admin returns 200). Let me check what the dashboard exception is:

reasoning_content:
Login was successful:
- POST login → 302 redirect to `/` (authenticated!)
- GET /admin → 200, title "Admin" (admin interface accessible)

So the admin login admin@consul.dev / Aa12345678 works via the documented credentials.

/admin/dashboard throws an exception — let me check the content of that exception. But that might be due to the missing seed data (debates/proposals are empty because db:dev_seed was interrupted). Let me check the dashboard exception.
